explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of all blessings and the holy standard for life.
A term referring to Jesus Christ, who serves as the foundation of God's spiritual temple where believers are built together.
A description of those who have not chosen or accepted Jesus' salvation and thus stand outside the holy community.
A term for Christians who are selected to be God's own people with a special mission in the world.
A description of all believers who have the right and duty to offer spiritual sacrifices through Jesus Christ.
The concept of God's new people, where the boundaries between Jews and Gentiles are dissolved by God's grace.
A term indicating that believers belong directly to God and live under His rule.
God-given favor and prosperity given to show who one is and what grace one has received.
The concept of the Christian witness that should shine in darkness and reveal God's good deeds.
Description of natural, earthly desires that oppose God's will and must be denied to live a holy life.
The concept of voluntary submission to authorities as part of Christian obedience to God.
Actions in accordance with God's law that should demonstrate the truth of faith and give glory to Him.
